quorum

quorum is the Crop Analytics Orchestra’s consensus layer. It never fits a model of its own: every estimate reaches it as a lens – a member’s fitter behind an adapter that declares what it shares with the other lenses (sampler, objective, priors, data preparation), the response shapes it can express, and its scope. A quorum of lenses that are independent enough of one another, and that agree, is what carries an answer; short of a quorum, quorum abstains rather than guessing. The three on-ramps by which a non-hub estimate becomes a lens stay in the package: simulation-ensemble ingestion, a distribution-preserving surrogate for an expensive simulator, and the koine fourth-opinion backend.

Rule in one line. A quorum of independent lenses must agree before an answer is carried; no quorum means abstain.

Related packages

  • MuMIn selects and averages models, weighting their parameters and predictions by information criteria or custom weights.
  • loo compares Bayesian models by approximate leave-one-out cross-validation and can average their predictive distributions by stacking.
  • metafor pools effect sizes from several studies with fixed-, random- and mixed-effects meta-analysis models.

These combine estimates into one weighted answer. quorum instead asks whether enough independent estimates of the same quantity agree, after declaring what each one shares with the others, and abstains when they do not.

Installation

quorum is not on CRAN. Install the development version from GitHub:

remotes::install_github("max578/quorum")

Minimal example

Two lenses, built from draws already in hand, compared and resolved through a declared policy:

library(quorum)

set.seed(1)
draws_a <- quorum_draws(list(`(Intercept)` = rnorm(500, 10, 1)),
                        source = "engine_a")
draws_b <- quorum_draws(list(`(Intercept)` = rnorm(500, 10.05, 1.02)),
                        source = "engine_b")

a <- lens_from_draws(draws_a, name = "a", member = "engine_a",
                     shares = c(sampler = "nuts", objective = "stan_a",
                               priors = "hub", data_prep = "hub"))
b <- lens_from_draws(draws_b, name = "b", member = "engine_b",
                     shares = c(sampler = "laplace", objective = "tmb",
                               priors = "hub", data_prep = "hub"))

verdict <- quorum(list(a, b),
                  policy = quorum_policy(order = c("a", "b"), min_lenses = 2L))
print(verdict)
#> <quorum verdict> status: concordant
#>   lenses: 2 (2 contributing, 0 abstained)
#>   carried: a (decide) -> no number issued
#>   findings: 0
#>   independence: Agreement between lenses fitted to the same data is agreement, not corroboration of a shared data fact.
